text.offer: Frisconar says, "In the Forests of Meridian there is an old oak smothered in webs, and beneath it the Spider Nest, and in the nest a queen as big as a wagon. Every spider in those woods is her get. Her venom would keep my shop for a year, but I am an old man. Kill her. And take friends: she is far stronger than anything you've met, and her children will swarm you."
text.progress: Frisconar says, "The way into the nest is the hole in a web-covered tree in the Forests of Meridian. Go in a group, and go well fed."
text.complete: Frisconar says, "The queen, dead? Then the forest will be quieter for a while, until another takes her place. Here, you've earned this."

steps.objective: Slay the queen spider in the Spider Nest
